name: Flash Sheet
tagline: Booking software that doesn't act like it's still 2009.
positioning: The booking, deposits, and calendar system built for tattoo shops that are tired of running the front desk out of a DM inbox and a shoebox of cash.

hero.h1: Stop running your shop out of a DM inbox.
hero.sub: Flash Sheet takes deposits, fills chair time, and chases no-shows so you can actually tattoo. No more triple-booked Saturdays or ghosted consult replies.

features.title: Deposits that stick
features.description: Take a non-refundable deposit before the appointment exists. Auto-forfeit on no-shows, auto-apply to the final. Your chair time stops being free.

features.title: Per-artist calendars
features.description: Every artist gets their own bookable calendar with their own rules, rates, and blackout days. The front desk sees all of it in one screen.

features.title: Flash drops
features.description: Post a flash sheet, let clients claim designs first-come-first-served, and watch the slots fill without answering 40 messages.

features.title: No-show recovery
features.description: Automatic reminders, deposit rules, and a waitlist that texts the next person the second a slot opens up.

features.title: Consent, signed
features.description: Digital consent forms, ID capture, and aftercare sheets stored per client. Auditable, dated, and never in a shoebox.

features.title: Shop numbers
features.description: Revenue per artist, chair utilization, deposit conversion. The stuff your accountant keeps asking for, finally in one place.

testimonials.quote: We were losing a grand a week to no-shows. Flash Sheet's deposit rules killed that in the first month. I stopped policing my own calendar.
testimonials.name: Dana Reyes

testimonials.quote: Flash drops are the only reason my Sundays are booked out. I post the sheet, go to bed, and wake up to a full day. It's almost insulting how easy it is.
testimonials.name: Marcus Vela

testimonials.quote: Onboarding four artists took an afternoon, not a meeting. Each one runs their own book and I still see the whole shop. That never happened with our old spreadsheet.
testimonials.name: Priya Ansari

homepage.footerBlurb: Flash Sheet is booking software for tattoo shops that would rather tattoo. Deposits, calendars, and consent forms in one place.
